description: This file defines the ContentRepositoryFactory class which is responsible for providing instances of ContentRepository based on the application's configuration. It uses properties to determine whether to return a filesystem or S3 based implementation of ContentRepository.

classes.name: ContentRepositoryFactory
classes.description: Factory class to provide ContentRepository instances based on configuration.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the appropriate ContentRepository based on configuration settings.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the ContentRepository implementation corresponding to the specified StorageType.
